title: Almond Crumble Oatmeal Bars
description: Vegan oatmeal bars with a crunchy almond crumble topping, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: Line an 8x8 inch baking dish with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mix together oats, almond butter, maple syrup, coconut sugar, and nutmeg until well combined.
Press the mixture into the prepared baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix together almond flour and crumble.
Sprinkle the crumble mixture evenly over the top of the oat mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool completely before cutting into bars.
Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
